programme.title: MOTD Live: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Colombia v Portugal (Kick-off 12.30am). Gabby Logan presents all the action from both teams' third and final match in Group K, held at Miami Stadium in the USA.. Perhaps surprisingly given both teams have made a number of appearances in this competition over the years, this is the first meeting between the nations. Colombia find themselves at the top of the group after two wins from two, while Portugal are currently second with four points. A draw would be enough for both sides to progress to the knock-out stages, however if Portugal were to lose it would open the door for DR Congo to finish second if they were to beat Uzbekistan in the other Group K game tonight. With analysis from Wayne Rooney, Micah Richards and Lucas Leiva

programme.title: MOTD Live: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: New Zealand v Belgium (Kick-off 4.00am). Group G reaches a climax at BC Place Vancouver in Canada, with this first-ever meeting between the nations. It's perhaps not surprising that this is a first encounter, as the All Whites have only reached the World Cup finals on two previous occasions, the first of which was a memorable campaign back in 1982, when they lost all three matches but still managed to play a part in Scotland being eliminated at the first hurdle once again. Belgium are unlikely to have as much attention focused on them this time than in recent years, when they were often tipped for success, but that may remove some of the pressure that has weighed so heavily on their shoulders. Both of these sides need a victory here to have any chance of progressing to the knock-out stages, with the top two in the group facing each other in the other group match taking place tonight. New Zealand find themselves bottom of Group G with one point, while Belgium are third after two successive draws

programme.title: MOTD Live: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Algeria v Austria (Kick-off 3.00am). Coverage of the Group J match at Kansas City Stadium in the USA, as both sides play their final group game. This is just the second meeting between these two teams, with the previous coming 44 years ago in the first group stage of the 1982 World Cup. That fixture saw Austria come away with a 2-0 victory, which helped them progress to the next stage of the tournament at the expense of the Algerians in controversial circumstances. Austria and West Germany knew that a 1-0 win for the Germans in the final group game between the nations would see both teams progress, and so they played out the match without serious attempts to score once the Germans took the lead. This game became known as the 'Disgrace of Gijon' and led to FIFA changing the rules for future tournaments, with all final group games being held simultaneously to avoid a reoccurrence. Both of these teams have three points going into this last game and whoever wins here will finish second in the group behind Argentina. Austria have the slight advantage though and will finish second here if they avoid defeat due to their superior goal difference

Robert Rodriguez's action thriller, starring Antonio Banderas, Salma Hayek, Cheech Marin, Joaquim de Almeida, Steve Buscemi and Quentin Tarantino

programme.title: 3 Days to Kill (2014)
programme.desc: A CIA agent learns he is dying, and decides to quit the agency so he can spend his last few months trying to rebuild his relationship with his estranged daughter. He is tempted to go back on his word when an old colleague offers him an experimental drug that could save his life - if he agrees to carry out one last mission. Action thriller, starring Kevin Costner, Amber Heard and Hailee Steinfeld

programme.title: The Hitman's Apprentice (2012)
programme.desc: A bumbling teenager is offered a job by his mother's crime boss boyfriend. He is given the task of driving one of the gangster's business associates around town, only to find himself an assistant to a hitman on his last assignment, a mission that leads to a deadly encounter with a mysterious woman. Thriller, starring Tim Roth, Jack O'Connell and Talulah Riley

programme.title: 24 Hours in A&E
programme.desc: Cameras follow junior doctor Ming, who for the first time in his career carries out a needle aspiration on a 19-year-old patient brought into A&E with a collapsed lung. A woman who is 17 weeks pregnant falls down the stairs, and fears the accident may lead to a possible miscarriage. She recounts her struggles to conceive, and fears that if this pregnancy fails, she may never have a child

programme.title: 999: On the Front Line
programme.desc: A paramedic heads to a serious traffic collision where a truck has overturned, while others deal with one of the most challenging emergencies - a cardiac arrest in the street.

programme.title: 24 Hours in A&E
programme.desc: A 50-year-old woman is rushed to A&E having collapsed at work following a thunderclap headache, leaving doctors concerned that she may have a bleed on her brain. Her husband shares the story of how they met and the challenges they have had to overcome. Other patients include a 13-year-old boy hit by a car while riding his bike and a woman concerned by a headache, who describes her childhood spent in Zambia and Lancashire

programme.title: 24 Hours in A&E
programme.desc: Lynn is rushed to St George's after collapsing from a brain aneurysm. programme.desc: At the Bunkroom hostel in Chester, David Sharrock is determined to prove that hostelling is for everybody - even if his wife Victoria isn't convinced. programme.title: Four in a Bed

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Finance director Jane hosts the second night in Leeds. Her plan to grab the grand is to treat her guests to a night of fine dining, but she has her work cut out. programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: The hosts meet one last time to settle scores and discover what they've been paid. programme.desc: A London Underground worker undergoes tests to look for signs of a heart attack after collapsing at a Tube station, and recalls the difficulties he faced in his childhood. programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: In York, part-time panto dame Graham Smith runs the Georgian House & Mews, and takes his guests back in time with a Nordic test of strength. programme.title: A Place in the Sun
programme.desc: Lisa and daughter Jordan are searching for their dream holiday home around the beautiful inland villages of Andalucía. However, while Seamus likes a modern style, Michael has much more traditional tastes, so with a budget of £175,000 and five options up his sleeve, Jonnie tries to come up with the perfect property to suit them both

programme.title: A Place in the Sun

programme.desc: Elvis fan Sandra and her husband Desmond seek help in their search for their dream holiday home near Mar Menor's stunning beaches on Spain's Costa Calida. Danni Menzies has five options for their £150,000 budget, but whether the couple will be impressed enough to put in an offer remains to be seen

The guests he's gunning to impress are 42-year-old coffee shop assistant Lisa, 63-year-old carpet layer Chris, 40-year-old singer Steph and 32-year-old comedian Sarah

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Comedian Sarah is the second to host in and around Liverpool, where she opts for an evening of hearty soul food. At the table, guests are shocked to find out about the host's day job and even more shocked to hear how one diner's love of kebabs derailed a night of passion

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Singing hairdresser Steph hosts the third dinner party of the competition and attempts to win over her guests with some Spanish food.

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: The penultimate host in and around Liverpool is coffee shop worker Lisa, who intends to treat her guests to the exotic flavours of Mexico. Even though she's never been there, her theory is that everyone likes chilli con carne. Chris doesn't disappoint with his choice of outfit and rocks up dressed as Pablo Escobar, the Columbian gangster. David and Steph discover that Lisa has a 'ladyship' title, while Sarah is confused by the margarita cheesecake thinking it'll be based on the pizza. There's more embarrassment for Sarah when she tells the group she thought Chris was dressed as Steph the previous night

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Last to host in Liverpool is carpet and flooring specialist Chris, who hopes his music-inspired nosh will send him to the top of the leaderboard. However, David is fired up and pitches a business plan to furnish budgie cages with carpet off cuts. programme.desc: The competition kicks off at the Laurel Bank Hotel in Fife. Owners Lee and Emma come out swinging during an afternoon at an Edwardian mansion complete with its own golf course

programme.desc: Gary and Chris host the week's final visit at The Grays Hotel in Blackpool. In addition to experiencing traumatic physical symptoms, women often struggle with related emotional stresses. programme.title: Egypt's Darkest Hour
programme.desc: Part one of two. Over 4,000 years ago, the ancient kingdom of Egypt, collapsed and disappeared. The mighty pharaohs, who had reigned supreme for more than seven centuries, lost control and the land was plunged into 150 years of chaos and civil war. programme.title: Ancient Egypt: Life and Death in the Valley of the Kings
programme.desc: Egyptologist Joann Fletcher looks at the lives of ordinary Egyptian citizens 3,500 years ago. In the first of two programmes, she explores the conditions of their tightly packed houses, how they dressed and what they ate. programme.title: Ancient Egypt: Life and Death in the Valley of the Kings

Joann Fletcher investigates the Ancient Egyptian attitude to death, revealing that to them life was just a dress rehearsal for the perfect afterlife that they were trying to reach. programme.desc: Cape Verde v Saudi Arabia (Kick-off 1.00am). All the action from both teams' third and final Group H match, held at Houston Stadium in the USA. Uruguay and Spain were the two favourites to qualify from this group, but even if both of these sides have failed to collect a point so far, with eight of the 12 third-placed teams qualifying for the last 32, three points here could be enough to see either one of them progress. The only time the Saudis managed to reach the knockout stage was in 1994, when the United States served as hosts, while this is the first time Cape Verde have played in the finals. programme.title: FIFA World Cup 26 Live
programme.desc: Panama v England (Kick-off 10.00pm). Coverage of the Group L match at New York/New Jersey Stadium in the USA, as the two sides play their final group game. This is just the second ever meeting between the two countries, with the first coming in the group stage of the 2018 World Cup in Russia. That game was a memorable one for the Three Lions as they brushed their opponents aside with a 6-1 victory. Braces from Harry Kane and John Stones, as well as a goal from Jesse Lingard, gave England a 5-0 lead at half-time before Kane completed his hat-trick in the second period. Panama did create some history in the second half as they scored their first ever goal at the World Cup thanks to a consolation finish from Felipe Baloy. The Three Lions will be hoping to finish top of this group with victory here after they missed their chance to progress to the knock-out stages in their last game against Ghana, as they were held to a 0-0 draw by the African country. Panama are already out of the competition after two 1-0 defeats by Ghana and Croatia.Tony O'Donoghue presents, with analysis from Kevin Doyle

programme.title: New Tricks
programme.desc: Sasha is forced to work with her ex-husband Ned Hancock when their teams investigate the death of film critic Oliver Houghton, whose body was discovered floating in the Thames. UCOS delves into the victim's past and explores his link to the murder of a conceptual artist 20 years previously, while Hancock's knowledge of London's hidden past proves invaluable when a piece of occult footage from the 1970s plunges the investigators into the macabre world of human sacrifice. Tamzin Outhwaite and Denis Lawson star, with a guest appearance by Barnaby Kay

programme.title: Silent Witness
programme.desc: Feature-length episode. Leo visits old college friend Sean Delaney at his psychiatric care centre in Essex, where one of the patients has been found dead in her bed. Although the coroner ruled a verdict of sudden-death syndrome, Delaney is not convinced and asks Leo to investigate. Suspicion soon falls on the dead girl's father, who has lost the family fortune, and his wife - but the pathologist runs into problems when the local detective sergeant makes it clear she is suspicious of his motives. Adrian Dunbar, Tamzin Outhwaite and Tom Ellis guest star

Amanda Redman stars, with Denis Lawson, Dennis Waterman and Nicholas Lyndhurst

Last ever episode of the comedy drama, starring Ian McShane, Dudley Sutton, Caroline Langrishe, Phyllis Logan and Chris Jury

programme.title: Agatha and the Truth of Murder
programme.desc: On January 12, 1920, Florence Nightingale Shore - a nurse and god-daughter of Florence Nightingale - is found brutally beaten on a train, dying four days later due to the extent of her injuries. Driven to distraction by the lack of progress and the failure of the police to catch the killer, Florence's longtime friend Mabel Rogers begins her own investigation and makes an appeal to Agatha Christie for help. Moved by the plea and eager for the chance to escape from professional and personal problems, the writer agrees to try to solve the case. Mystery, starring Ruth Bradley, Pippa Haywood and Tim McInnerny

programme.desc: After Sandra's departure, the detectives are anxious to meet their new boss, and DCI Sasha Miller wastes no time getting cracking with her first Ucos case, the murder of an Italian immigrant on a west London allotment 25 years earlier. The ritualistic style of the killing puts one of the other gardeners in the frame when it's revealed he is a practising druid. However, as the investigation continues, Gerry becomes suspicious of Sasha - why is she kissing a senior officer? Tamzin Outhwaite joins the cast as DCI Miller, with Dennis Waterman, Denis Lawson and Nicholas Lyndhurst

programme.title: The Bill
programme.desc: Conclusion of the two-part series finale, bringing to an end Britain's longest-running police procedural drama, which has been broadcast in 55 countries. programme.title: The Bill
programme.desc: Callum and Kirsty answer a call about a disturbance at the home of an elderly widow and discover she has been raped as well as burgled. A neighbour falls under suspicion, but CID have little hope of putting together a case as the victim proves reluctant to undergo a medical examination. The sergeant is also struggling with family problems after learning he may be running out of time to reach a reconciliation with his estranged father

programme.title: The Bill
programme.desc: A man found beaten to death near his local turns out to be a widower with a drink problem, who has been neglecting his two children and spending a lot of time in the pub with the landlord's attractive girlfriend (played by former EastEnders and Bad Girls actress Nicola Stapleton). Max returns to work following his run-in with Terry, but starts spreading rumours about a relationship between Grace and Neil, and it soon becomes clear he has not sorted out his drug problem

programme.title: The Bill
programme.desc: When a couple fail to turn up at the airport for a flight to Italy and their dog is found brutally killed in what appears to be a burglary at their home, suspicion falls on their son, who holds a grudge against his father for turning him in for possession of a class A drug. A neighbour produces mobile phone footage of the family car being torched by teenagers, one of whom is known to the police, and the case takes an unexpected twist when the Sun Hill team starts tracking the missing persons' bank account. Former EastEnders actor Stuart Laing (Rob Minter) guest stars

programme.title: The Bill
programme.desc: Kirsty calls for help when a woman is found unconscious and with multiple injuries beneath an open window. Callum eventually responds, having just learned of his father's death, but as the investigation slowly uncovers the activities and relationships of the residents of the house, the sergeant's distracted behaviour leads to a furious outburst against his colleague witnessed by Inspector Smith

programme.title: The Bill
programme.desc: Callum returns to work, determined to uncover the truth about the rape allegation that blackened his dead father's name as a police officer and divided the family for 20 years. Kirsty is shocked by the sergeant's brusque attitude in handling a vulnerable witness, and Smithy eventually realises his troubled colleague will stop at nothing to get a result against a knife-wielding blackmailer. Guest starring Lesley Vickerage (The Inspector Lynley Mysteries) and David Schofield (Pirates of the Caribbean)

programme.title: The Bill
programme.desc: In the first of a two-part series finale, a 14-year-old dies in Smithy's arms following a stabbing incident, and CCTV footage reveals he had been acting as a 'mule' for the older members of a gang. One of Mickey's informants is spotted at the crime scene and eventually gives vital evidence pointing to the most likely culprit, but the detective fears for her safety when she is released on bail and returns to the estate

programme.title: The Bill
programme.desc: Conclusion of the two-part series finale, bringing to an end Britain's longest-running police procedural drama, which has been broadcast in 55 countries. The show, which began life as one-off drama Woodentop in 1984, broke new ground by exploring the lives and loves of the officers of the fictional London station of Sun Hill. Callum finally proves himself to Smithy as they hunt the members of the Parkway Crew responsible for the death of Liam Martin, and Mickey goes all-out to get justice for his informant Jasmine Harris following the gang rape

On his way to Bangladesh, he hitches a ride on a trawler, highlighting one of the Indian Ocean's fastest-growing industries - providing prawns for the West. But as he reveals, it comes at a price for the environment

programme.title: Indian Ocean with Simon Reeve
programme.desc: The adventurer begins the final leg of his journey on the northern tip of Sumatra in western Indonesia, near the epicentre of the 2004 Boxing Day tsunami, finding out how the province of Banda Aceh has undergone many changes since the disaster.
